name: boAt Airdopes Supreme
desc:

name: Charger Protector & Cable Protector
desc:
Product Title
3 Pcs Spiral Cable Protector + 8 Pcs Silicone End Protectors Combo Set for Smartphone Chargers, Laptops & Earphones

Key Features / Bullet Points
Complete Protection Combo: Includes 3 long spiral cable wraps along with 8 colorful silicone end bite protectors, providing complete coverage against fraying and snapping.

Prevents Cable Breakage: Cable ends are the most vulnerable points; these protectors stop severe 90-degree bending at the connector joints, significantly extending cable lifespan.

Full-Length Wire Coverage: The 3 flexible spiral cords allow you to fully wrap charging cables or earphone cords, preventing exterior damage, scratches, and tangled messes.

Universal Compatibility: Fits virtually all charging cords, including iPhone Lightning cables, Type-C cables, Micro-USB cords, laptop charger wires, and wired earphones.

Durable & Flexible Material: Made of soft-touch, high-grade silicone and flexible TPU that retains elasticity and will not slip or deform over time.

Tool-Free Installation: Easy to wrap on by hand in seconds—simply align the top slot with the connector and twist along the wire until fully secured.

Product Description
Protect your expensive charging cables and earphone wires from everyday wear and tear!

Frequent bending and pulling often lead to cracked outer insulation, exposed wires, and sudden charging failures. This Spiral Cable & End Protector Set provides reliable, 360-degree reinforcement to keep your cords intact, safe, and organized.

Package Includes:

3 × Full-Length Spiral Cable Wraps (Assorted Colors)

8 × Silicone Cable End Protectors (Assorted Colors)

Why Choose This Cable Protector Set?

Cost-Effective: Extends the working life of your original cables, saving you the expense of frequent replacements.

Neat & Tangle-Free: Keeps desk cables organized and prevents knots while carrying them in bags or pockets.

Multi-Device Support: Suitable for household phone chargers, tablet cables, USB cords, and laptop power cables.
